purpose: Source-metadata correction and operational routing of substantive cross-domain publications/patents surfaced during exact W II level searches.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: Social Mobility in the Long Run: An Analysis of Tongcheng, China, 1300 to 1900
sources.authority: Journal of Economic History / Cambridge Core
sources.note: Off-domain search result. Reuse its transition-matrix framing as a generic state-transition comparison method for OVERWATCH; retain off-domain provenance as a context-control example, not Glob evidence.

sources.title: A review on chemical and mechanical phenomena at the wafer interface during chemical mechanical planarization
sources.authority: Journal of Materials Research / Cambridge Core
sources.note: Route to materials/process knowledge for tungsten/cobalt metallization and chemical-mechanical-planarization interface phenomena; useful for manufacturing/surface-finish modeling, not Glob-number evidence.

sources.title: Electro-optic element
sources.authority: U.S. patent publication record surfaced via Justia
sources.note: Route as prior-art/material-property intelligence for electrochromic/optical multilayers. Includes tungsten/tungsten-oxide options and example optical constants; validate against primary patent/measurement sources before design use.

sources.title: Bench-top Time of Flight mass spectrometer
sources.authority: U.S. patent publication record surfaced via Justia
sources.note: Route to instrumentation knowledge: tungsten-wire grid-electrode construction, support geometry, interlocks, and operating-state logic. Treat as patent/prior-art engineering information, not scientific validation.

sources.title: A gesture-based behaviour-driven development approach for end-user cobot programming
sources.note: Route gesture-to-symbol mapping, behavior-driven scenario syntax, and finite-state-machine execution concepts into future human/cobot orchestration and observable state-transition workflows.

source_corrections.reason: The peer-reviewed Journal of Physics B article is volume 43 (2010), article 144003; a 2011 repository/manuscript-version timestamp should not be used as the journal publication year.
source_corrections.identifier_stability_rule: Keep the existing source_id for referential stability; consumers must apply the correction record when presenting bibliographic metadata.

relational_tests.claims_boundary: Cross-domain usefulness does not convert search-engine co-occurrence into numerical or physical evidence.

next_actions: Keep cross-domain search spillover source-bounded so useful methods are retained without allowing uncontrolled topic expansion.
Run topology-preserving tests only on predeclared physical datasets and target sets.
Apply multiple-testing correction to Glob hypothesis tests; cross-domain methodology reuse is not part of the hypothesis hit count.
Where patent-derived values influence a design, reconcile them against the primary patent and independent material-property measurements before PRIME SENTINEL approval.
